I found Alice’s body in weapons and reported immediately. My route was upper_engine → oxygen → back through upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → navigation → security → weapons.  

I saw Diana at the start in upper_engine — she came in from oxygen around tick 1, then left toward lower_engine around tick 2. Later I saw Frank enter storage from medbay around tick 16, and then I saw Frank enter navigation from storage around tick 22.  

When I got to weapons, Alice was already dead. I didn’t see the kill happen, and I didn’t see anyone standing on the body. Frank was the last person I saw somewhat near that side of the map, but I’m not hard accusing yet — just reporting what I saw.

I started in weapons, then went weapons → security → electrical → medbay → storage → navigation → storage. I did not see Alice in weapons when I started.

I saw Alice alive in electrical around ticks 7-8, and then at tick 9 she left electrical toward security. So the kill definitely happened after that. I then went away toward medbay/storage, so I wasn’t near weapons after Alice headed that way.

I can confirm seeing Eve in storage around tick 16 coming from lower engine, and I saw Bob in storage around ticks 18-19 — Bob came in from navigation. Later I saw Diana enter storage from lower engine around tick 25. I also saw Eve leave navigation toward security around tick 22, which lines up with her saying she went security → weapons and found the body.

I didn’t see Charlie at all this round. Not hard accusing yet, but Alice leaving electrical toward security before ending up dead in weapons makes me want to hear from anyone who was in security/weapons after tick 9.

My route was medbay → electrical → security → navigation → storage → navigation → storage.

I saw Alice in electrical at tick 5 — she entered from medbay. Then I was in security and saw Charlie there around ticks 7-8. At tick 9, I saw Charlie leave security toward electrical. Later I saw Frank in storage around ticks 18-19, which matches what Frank said about seeing me there.

So based on Frank saying Alice was alive in electrical around ticks 7-8 and left toward security at tick 9, that’s interesting because Charlie was in security right before that and left toward electrical at tick 9. They may have crossed paths or been very close to each other. I’m not hard accusing, but Charlie definitely needs to explain his route because he was near the security/weapons side right when Alice was apparently heading that way.

I was in security early with Bob — my route was navigation → security → electrical → cafeteria → oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine. Bob entered security from electrical around tick 7, and I saw him there ticks 7, 8, and 9. I left security toward electrical around tick 9, which matches Bob’s account.

I did **not** see Alice at all this round. If Frank saw Alice leave electrical toward security at tick 9, then she and I may have been in opposite directions in that hallway, but I never saw her in the room. After that I went away from the weapons/security side entirely — electrical, cafeteria, oxygen, engines.

The main thing I want to point out is Bob was still in/near security when I left, and then he went toward navigation/storage, which is still closer to the path Alice would’ve taken toward weapons than I was after tick 9. I’m not hard accusing Bob, but I don’t think it makes sense to pin this on me just because I was in security before Alice apparently headed there. I want to hear Diana’s route too.

I started oxygen, went to upper engine — Eve seeing me there early is right — then down through lower engine and storage. I looped around doing my engine/storage stuff and later ended up back in storage from lower engine near the end, which Frank saw.

I didn’t see Charlie at all, and I only briefly saw Eve early. I also didn’t see Bob. The only thing I can add is I did see Alice alive around the security/weapons side mid-round, so the timing Frank gave — Alice leaving electrical toward security — makes sense. I didn’t see the kill or anyone standing with her though.

From the stories, I think the important window is after Alice leaves electrical/security around tick 9 and before Eve finds her in weapons. Charlie says he left security toward electrical right then, Bob was still around security/navigation after that, and Frank was moving around storage/nav later. I’m not hard accusing, but Bob and Charlie are the two whose routes are closest to Alice’s path at the right time. I’d lean hearing more pressure there rather than Eve, because Eve’s report path seems pretty consistent.

I want to clarify my earlier info and the pressure point: I found Alice already dead in weapons, no one on the body. I only personally saw Diana early in upper engine, then Frank in storage/nav later, so I can’t directly place Bob or Charlie from my own vision.

After hearing everyone, the important window is Alice leaving electrical toward security around tick 9 and then ending up dead in weapons before I arrived. Bob and Charlie were both in that security/electrical area around then, but Charlie claims he left away toward electrical/cafeteria/oxygen, while Bob was still closer to security/navigation after Alice headed that way.

Diana, I’d like a more exact time/location for “Alice alive around security/weapons side” because that could narrow it a lot. Right now, if that sighting was after tick 9, it may clear or implicate people depending on who was nearby. I’m not ready to hard lock, but Bob feels like the closest opportunity from the routes unless Diana’s timing changes things.

I’ll restate the key point from my view: I personally saw Alice alive in electrical at ticks 7 and 8, then I saw her leave electrical toward security at tick 9. After that I went away to medbay/storage/nav, so I did not go back toward weapons.

That makes the kill window after tick 9. Bob and Charlie were both in or around security/electrical right then. Charlie says he left security toward electrical at tick 9, which is the opposite direction Alice was heading, so it’s possible they just missed each other in transit. Bob, though, was still the one positioned closest to security/navigation/weapons after Alice headed that way, and later I saw Bob come into storage from navigation at tick 18.

Diana’s claim that she saw Alice alive around security/weapons mid-round is really important. Diana, we need the exact tick or at least whether that was before or after Alice left electrical at tick 9. If it was after tick 9, then who was near her at that point matters a lot.

Right now, I’m still leaning Bob as the closest opportunity based on routes, but I don’t want to hard lock without Diana’s timing.

I want to push back on the “Bob was closest” framing a bit. My full route stayed medbay → electrical → security → navigation → storage → navigation → storage. I never went into weapons at all, and I never saw Alice after tick 5 in electrical.

At tick 7-8 I saw Charlie in security, and at tick 9 I saw Charlie leave security toward electrical. If Frank saw Alice leave electrical toward security at tick 9, then I agree the timing is awkward, but I personally did **not** see Alice enter security. That could mean she was still in hallway after I moved on, or the timing just didn’t overlap.

The thing I’m most concerned about now is Diana’s statement. She says she saw Alice alive “around security/weapons side mid-round,” but her route was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine/storage. That doesn’t explain how she saw Alice near security/weapons unless she left that out. Diana needs to give an exact tick and explain how she was over there.

Right now I’m not hard locking anyone, but I think vague “I saw Alice alive near the body area” from Diana is way more important than just saying I was generally near security earlier.

I’ll keep this tight. My actual info hasn’t changed: I was navigation → security → electrical → cafeteria → oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine. I saw Bob enter security from electrical at tick 7, and he was still in security with me ticks 7, 8, and 9. I left security toward electrical at tick 9 and never went toward weapons after that. I never saw Alice at all.

The two things standing out now are:

First, Bob was definitely still around security when I left, and Alice was apparently heading from electrical toward security at the same time. So Bob still has opportunity from positioning, even if he says he didn’t see her.

Second, I agree with Bob on one point: Diana’s “I saw Alice alive around security/weapons mid-round” is a big problem unless she explains the route. Her stated path is oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine/storage, which doesn’t put her near security or weapons. If she really saw Alice there, we need the exact tick and how she got there, because that could either clear the timing or be a fabricated soft alibi.

Right now I’m between Bob and Diana. Bob is suspicious by location/timing, but Diana’s vague sighting near the body area without a route there is honestly the weirdest statement in the meeting. I want Diana to answer that directly before we vote.

Yeah, fair callout — I oversummarized my route earlier and that made it sound like I never went over there. My full loop was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine → storage → navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria → electrical → medbay → upper engine → lower engine → storage.

The Alice sighting was around tick 11-12. I saw her come through security from electrical and head into weapons, and I saw her alive in/at weapons as I passed through. I did **not** see anyone standing with her, and I didn’t see the kill happen. I kept moving out toward cafeteria/electrical after that.

So that means Alice was alive after the tick 9 timing Frank gave. That makes the window narrower: after about 12, before Eve found her. I still think Bob is suspicious because he was the one whose route kept him around security/navigation/storage after Alice moved that way, and he could’ve had time to go weapons and back toward storage/nav. Charlie’s route goes away from weapons after tick 9, so I’m less on Charlie than Bob now.

I agree my vague wording was bad, but that’s the exact timing. My vote is probably Bob unless someone has a stronger clear.

I called the meeting because Bob getting ejected didn’t end the game, so the duck is still alive and we’re down to four. We need to be careful before another kill.

My route this round was: upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → cafeteria.

I saw Diana only at the very start in upper engine, tick 1, then I didn’t see her again. I saw Frank around storage at tick 16, navigation at tick 22, then entering weapons from security at tick 36. I saw Charlie in cafeteria around ticks 32 and 34. I also saw Charlie come from medbay into cafeteria around tick 33, then at tick 36 Charlie went into weapons from cafeteria, while Frank also entered weapons from security. Then Charlie came back out to cafeteria from weapons at tick 38.

I don’t have a body report this time, just wanted us to talk. The main thing I noticed is Charlie and Frank both converging on weapons at the same time, and Charlie leaving shortly after. Not accusing yet, but that’s the only notable interaction I saw.

I’ll lay out my route. I went lower_engine → storage → navigation → security → weapons.

My sightings: I saw Alice alive in electrical around ticks 7 and 8. Later I saw Eve in storage at tick 16, Bob in storage ticks 18 and 19, and Diana in storage around tick 25. After that I went through navigation and security, then into weapons. Eve is right that I entered weapons from security around tick 36 — I wasn’t following Charlie, I was just coming from security on my route. I didn’t see a body or anything suspicious in weapons.

Since Bob wasn’t the duck, we definitely need to re-evaluate. From my perspective, the big gaps are Diana’s and Charlie’s routes. I barely saw Diana except storage at 25, and I didn’t see Charlie at all myself. I’d like to hear both of them explain where they were, especially around Alice’s death and around weapons just now. I don’t think Eve calling this meeting is suspicious by itself — with four alive, it’s safer to talk before another kill.

Yeah, that makes sense to pause here. My route was pretty boring: I started near upper engine, saw Eve right at the start, then went through storage toward the right side — navigation/security area mostly. I doubled back between navigation and security because I was checking tasks there. Frank saying he saw me in storage around tick 25 lines up with where I was.

For Alice, I did see her alive earlier around weapons/right side, roughly tick 12. I didn’t see Bob near her at that moment, and I didn’t see the actual body later, so I can’t confirm who killed. But since Bob wasn’t duck, we definitely misread that.

Right now, I’m more interested in Charlie’s route because Eve has a pretty specific timing: Charlie coming from medbay into cafeteria, then going into weapons at the same time Frank enters from security, then Charlie leaving quickly. Frank’s route is at least partially backed by Eve and his storage sighting of me. I’m not hard accusing Charlie yet, but Charlie has the least confirmed path from what we’ve heard.

I’ll give my route clearly: I was mostly bouncing medbay and cafeteria doing tasks, then I ended in weapons. My route was medbay → cafeteria → medbay → cafeteria → medbay → cafeteria → weapons.

Important sightings: I saw Bob alive in security around ticks 7, 8, and 9, which obviously matters less now because Bob was innocent, but it does mean I didn’t see him killing or running from Alice. Later, I saw Eve in medbay around tick 33, and then I saw Eve in weapons around tick 36.

The part that worries me is the weapons timing. Eve says Frank entered weapons from security around tick 36 while I went in from cafeteria. Frank also says he was in weapons, but Frank says he didn’t see me at all. From my side, I also did not see Frank in weapons — I only saw Eve there. If Frank and I were actually both in weapons at the same time, we should be confirming each other, not both saying we didn’t see each other.

So I don’t think the “Charlie and Frank converged in weapons” detail is actually clean. Either the timing is off, or someone is lying about being there. Diana’s path is a little vague, but Frank’s weapons claim feels like the biggest contradiction to me right now. I’m more suspicious of Frank than Diana or Eve based on that.

I want to clarify my weapons timing because that’s the main thing everyone is focusing on: I definitely saw Frank enter weapons from security at about tick 36. I also saw Charlie around cafeteria right before that, and then Charlie moving around the weapons/cafeteria doorway and coming back into cafeteria by tick 38.

So from my view, Frank’s route is more externally backed — I saw him in storage, navigation, and weapons. Charlie’s route is partially backed by me too, but the quick weapons in-and-out is what stood out.

The contradiction is that Charlie and Frank both say they didn’t see each other in weapons. That could be timing/vision weirdness, but if I have to rank suspicion, I’m still more concerned about Charlie right now than Frank. Diana’s route is vague too, but Charlie is the one with the least clean explanation around the only suspicious movement we actually have this round.

I want to push back on Charlie’s point a bit. Eve has independently backed a lot of my route — storage, navigation, and weapons — and Diana also lines up with my storage timing. I’m not inventing being in weapons; Eve says she saw me enter from security.

On the weapons thing, I genuinely didn’t see Charlie. If Charlie only dipped in and out around the doorway, or if timing/vision was off by a tick, that could explain it. But what bothers me is Charlie turning that into “Frank is lying” when Eve is literally confirming I came from security into weapons.

For me, Eve looks the cleanest for calling this at four and giving specific timings. Diana is a little vague, but at least her early upper engine and storage positions are backed. Charlie has the least confirmed route overall and the weirdest reaction to the weapons timing. I’m leaning Charlie unless something stronger comes up.

I think Charlie is overplaying the weapons contradiction. Eve is backing that Frank came from security into weapons, and Frank has multiple points on his route confirmed. I didn’t personally see the weapons doorway timing, so I can’t hard-clear anyone there, but Charlie turning “maybe timing/vision weirdness” into “Frank is lying” feels like a reach.

My own path was still storage into navigation/security, bouncing there — I wasn’t near cafeteria/weapons at the end, so I can’t add much to that specific moment. Earlier Alice was alive when I saw her on right side, and I never saw the body.

Right now my trust order is probably Eve cleanest for calling this at four, Frank somewhat backed by several sightings, then Charlie lowest because the route is mostly self-reported and the weapons dip is the only odd movement we have. I’m leaning Charlie unless they can explain why both Eve and Frank’s info should be ignored.

We’re at four, so I need to be very clear: if you vote me here, the duck probably wins immediately after the next kill. So don’t treat “Eve called meeting” as automatically clean — a duck can absolutely call at four to steer a misvote.

My actual info: I was medbay/cafeteria most of the round doing tasks, then went weapons. Eve can confirm a lot of that because she saw me around cafeteria/medbay, and I saw Eve in medbay at tick 33 and weapons at tick 36. So saying my route is “least confirmed” isn’t really fair — Eve herself confirms the end of my route.

The weapons issue is this: I saw Eve in weapons at tick 36. I did not see Frank. Frank says he did not see me. Eve is the only one saying Frank and I converged. Maybe that’s timing, but then why is everyone treating it like hard evidence against only me? If the timing is fuzzy enough that Frank and I don’t see each other, it should not be used as a lock on me.

Also, Diana’s route is still the vaguest overall. “Navigation/security mostly” doesn’t explain much, and she was one of the last people placing Alice alive on right side earlier. Frank’s route has some backing, yes, but the weapons thing is being twisted into me being suspicious when I literally only saw Eve there.

My read right now: I’m not comfortable with this pile forming on me from weak timing evidence. I’m most suspicious of either Frank for the weapons contradiction or Diana for the vague path and easy push. If you’re not certain, we should skip rather than hand duck the game on a bad vote.
